content.text: In countries like Nigeria and Venezuela, conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-what-actually-how-4|COREMERCH guide to payment]] platforms like Stripe and PayPal fail to provide the necessary infrastructure for digital creators. This gap leaves many talented individuals unable to monetize their products effectively. COREMERCH provides a robust solution through Stack 02, leveraging Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and NOWPayments. This guide will walk you through [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/building-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-every-detail-you-2|Crypto Payment]]-store-cloudflare-pages-step-step-deployment-11|building]] your crypto store using this stack, ensuring you can operate independently and securely without reliance on restrictive platforms.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms often exclude creators in regions facing financial restrictions and currency instability. COREMERCH's infrastructure is designed to counter these limitations by offering complete ownership of your online store. With tools like Cloudflare and NOWPayments, you gain sovereignty over your commerce operations. This architecture allows you to accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, eliminating the barriers posed by conventional banking systems. Your store stands resilient against currency collapse, ensuring consistent revenue generation.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before initiating your deployment, gather essential resources. You'll need a Cloudflare account, access to Google Apps Script, and a NOWPayments account for cryptocurrency transactions. Familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint, which serves as your guide for deployment and integration. Additionally, prepare your digital products for upload, ensuring they meet your audience's needs. Having these elements ready will streamline your setup process and ensure a smooth transition to live operations.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your payment layer with NOWPayments, which will handle cryptocurrency transactions efficiently. Set up Webhooks to receive payment confirmations automatically, allowing for real-time order fulfillment. Next, integrate Google Apps Script to manage order processing and product delivery seamlessly. This backend logic will serve as the backbone of your store, ensuring that once a payment is confirmed, your customers receive their digital products instantly. This setup guarantees minimal friction in the purchasing experience.
Infrastructure sovereignty ensures you own your commerce architecture outright.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it's time to go live. Navigate to your Cloudflare Pages site and ensure everything is functioning correctly. Conduct a test transaction using a cryptocurrency of your choice to confirm that the payment process and product delivery work seamlessly. This test will provide confidence in your system's reliability. After validating your setup, promote your store to potential customers, leveraging social media and existing networks to drive traffic and sales.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your store is live and processing transactions, consider how to scale your operations. Monitor sales data through your backend and identify which products perform best. You can expand your offerings based on customer demand. Additionally, explore different marketing strategies to increase visibility. As your revenue grows, consider investing in enhanced features or additional products, ensuring your infrastructure remains capable of handling increased traffic and transactions without compromising performance.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, start by deploying Stack 02 using Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments. This setup allows you to host your site and process transactions without traditional payment platform restrictions. Focus on integrating your backend with NOWPayments for seamless payment processing and product delivery.
Processing payments in crypto eliminates reliance on traditional banking systems.

Creators at the store setup stage comparing Stack 01 and Stack 02 are typically choosing between building it themselves with the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 — which covers both stacks in complete detail with full source code — or having COREMERCH deploy the complete Edge Stack under their accounts with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Both result in the same ownership structure: your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your Supabase database, your NOWPayments account, your wallet, your store. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Apps Script for deployment, which typically takes 4-6 hours. In contrast, Stack 02 employs Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, offering a more robust solution deployed by COREMERCH within 48 hours and fully tested before handover.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages allow you to host a digital product store. GitHub Pages may be ideal for simpler setups, while Cloudflare Pages offers enhanced capabilities through Workers, making it suitable for more complex applications.

What cryptocurrencies can I accept through NOWPayments?

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, providing a wide range of options for your customers. This flexibility allows you to cater to various preferences and market demands, enhancing your store's appeal.
